proposed_facts.reason: Independently read every cited range. ARInit calls the capacity probe on its initialization path; the probe publishes its computed byte capacity to __AR_Size, and ARGetSize returns it unchanged. The caller immediately frees ARAlloc(0x20), retaining its address as the arena lower boundary. Its conditional expression evaluates the second ARGetSize call only when the first result is at most 16 MiB. The functionality document agrees and preserves exceptional probe branches. Existing names and inherited retained knowledge require no overrides.
